description: An AI-first workspace home: a hero with starter prompts, a sticky prompt bar that opens a new conversation, a resume affordance for unfinished work, recent conversations, and a compact plan/usage strip. Configurable through lib/dashboard-config.tsx (copy, starters, chat base path, shortcuts) and lib/dashboard-data.ts (what "resume" means). Pairs with the chat item for its /chat routes and the pricing item for lib/billing-config.ts's CURRENCY; install those first.
